id.description: Stable slug, <manufacturer-slug>-<model-slug>. Never renamed once assigned.

name.description: Display name. Correctable without breaking id-based lookups.

manufacturer.description: Must match the vendor file this entry lives in (enforced by the validator, not this schema).

vramGb.description: VRAM in GB. For an Apple Silicon SoC, this is the unified-memory capacity for that configuration (shared by CPU and GPU), not dedicated VRAM.

architecture.description: Context only, e.g. 'Ada Lovelace'. Never used for matching/lookup logic.
